own: In our Q&A or our rule list that we have with the site, we will have pre-written rules for bans and what kind of punishment comes with that type of ban. If you did this and it results in a ban, the ban would be for this period of time. If it's this type of offence, then the ban is this period of time. If it's multiple offences, the first time the ban is at the moderator's discretion for how long it is, and the third time it's a lifetime ban. But some things can be a lifetime ban from the very beginning, like scamming. So we need to really write out a rule list when we get to that point.
